description: Remove environment variables set on an app or agent, and schedule one restart if it is running. This removes the service's own variables only; an organization variable it inherits is not touched. A variable a connector or channel references, or one a resource set, is refused: the answer names the holder and what frees it. A channel the agent owns is destroyed with destroy_channel; a resource's variables leave only when the resource is detached. A name that is not set is reported and does not fail the call. Requires connecting a Valet account.

names.description: The names of the service's own variables to remove. Matching ignores case.

org_name.description: The Valet organization it belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: unset_env_vars

name.description: Name of the app or agent the variables were removed from.

not_set.description: Names the service had no variable under, sorted. They are not an error. Empty when every name was set.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

removed.description: Names removed, sorted, as stored. Empty when nothing was removed.

title: Unset environment variables
